question: _______ is a dance which combines speech, mime and pure dance.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kuchipudi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Kuchipudi:**

__
 
• It is a traditional Indian classical dance that originated in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is an expressive dance form that combines dance, music, and drama.
 
• This requires extensive footwork.
 
• It is one of the major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• It originated in a village called Kuchipudi in the state of Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• It is a dance-drama performance that has its roots in the ancient Hindu Sanskrit texts of Natya Shastra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Bharatanatyam:**

 
• It is a classical dance of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The origin of this classical dance is from Natya Shastra.

**Kathakali:**

 
• It is a classical Indian dance form which is a story theater style of art which is the folk dance of Kerala.
 
• It is a combination of 5 forms of fine arts which are -
 
 
• Natyam (expression).
 
• Nritham (dance).
 
• Nrityam (act).
 
• Sangeetham (music).
 
• Vadya (Instrument)
